sloka: ततः तैः चोदिता सा नौः कर्ण धार समाहिता ।शुभ स्फ्य वेग अभिहता शीघ्रम् सलिलम् अत्यगात् ॥२-५२-८१॥
transliteration: tataḥ taiḥ coditā sā nauḥ karṇa dhāra samāhitā ।śubha sphya vega abhihatā śīghram salilam atyagāt ॥2-52-81॥

translations.english: The wellruddered boat rowed by the helmsmen and propelled by strong oars, swiftly crossed the waters of the river.
